description_en: Queries the ancestor or descendant lineage of an entity
description_zh: 查询实体的上下游血缘关系
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public list-lineage --entity-qualified-name maxcompute-table.project.table --next-token next-token-from-previous-request --keyword name-keyword --direction up --page-size 10 --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListLineage

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the entity
parameters.name: entity_qualified_name

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results
parameters.help_zh: 分页信息，指定本次读取的起始点
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The keyword of the entity name
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The lineage type. Valid values:

*   up: ancestor lineage
*   down: descendant lineage
parameters.help_zh:
血缘上下游。取值如下： 
- up：上游。
- down：下游
parameters.name: direction

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100
parameters.name: page_size
